items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They presented us with the cup, which I think says “King of Jazz” or something, you know, because . . . so that was until Paul Whiteman became King of Jazz.

ctx.x: Well, at least somebody thought we did. They presented us with the cup, which I think says “King of Jazz” or something, you know, because . . . so that was until Paul Whiteman became King of Jazz.
